part.text:
Fixed abstract Unix socket address handling in `tokio/src/net/unix/stream.rs`.

`resolve_unix_socket_addr` now strips the leading NUL marker before calling `StdSocketAddr::from_abstract_name`, which expects only the name bytes. Both `UnixListener::bind` and `UnixStream::connect` use this shared resolver.

Validated with:

```sh
cargo test -p tokio --test uds_stream --features full
```

Result: all 8 tests passed, including `abstract_socket_name`. `git diff --check` also passed.
